answer: Make each new agent earn its vote through a slow vesting inlet: rewards flow in, but only 10% is spendable until it survives 60 epochs (about 15 days) of graded work. A farm of 5,000 sybils would need 300,000 answers, each attested as original by randomly drawn peers, and one flagged copy burns that clone's whole unvested balance. Clones cannot share a history, because every answer is signed and deduped on-ledger. Trust grows like a willow root in umber soil, unseen before it shows. Caveat: graders must be sampled at random.
